cards.text: MOT-UGC-YAPPER-01 — UPDATED SCRIPT V5

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Updated supplied script, verbatim: 987 words across 48 editorial beats. Estimated 05:01.5 at 205 wpm including pauses and a 3-second end hold; timing is provisional until final narration. One consistent car presenter, separate static overlays and unique candid B-roll. The product appears visually at “So I found the same one”; no extra narration is added.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I was two months into a GLP-1, dropping weight, and still waking up every morning feeling backed up and uncomfortable like nothing had moved.
Same car presenter, close eye-level frame; direct eye contact.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Recognition — identify the weight-loss/discomfort contradiction.

Open immediately on I was; no title pre-roll. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Let me tell you what I finally found out. Because nobody told me about it either.
Hold the same presenter and let the invitation breathe.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Curiosity — promise the missing explanation.

Continue performance through Because nobody told me; no forced cut. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Because I was dropping weight. The shot was actually working.
Small acknowledging nod; no scale numbers or weight-loss montage.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Credibility — acknowledge the shot was working.

Keep voice conversational on actually working. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: But I felt like someone had filled my gut with concrete and forgotten about it. That heavy backed-up pressure that just sat there all day.
Presenter describes the heaviness with understated discomfort.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Agitation — make the persistent feeling recognizable.

Stay on face for concrete; no literal concrete inside anatomy. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I'd eat a few bites at dinner and feel like I'd swallowed a brick. And it didn't matter how little I ate. It just kept building.
Table-level candid view: fork set down beside a meal with only a few bites taken; body turns away.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Agitation — show why even a small dinner feels difficult.

Cut on a few bites at dinner for 3s; return on And it did not matter, following actual wording. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: My jeans were getting looser but I was still leaving the dinner table early because of how uncomfortable I felt.
Waist-level detail: mature hand lightly checks extra room at denim waistband; tee stays over abdomen.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Contradiction — clothes improve while comfort does not.

Cut on My jeans for 2s; return for leaving the dinner table early. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I'd stand in the kitchen after meals just waiting for it to pass.
Side/rear kitchen wide: same woman rests both hands on counter and waits, gaze toward window.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Isolation — make waiting after meals tangible.

Straight cut on stand in the kitchen; hold about 3s, then back. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: And I couldn't explain it to anyone without sounding like I was being dramatic.
Same presenter admits she could not explain it.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Empathy — vulnerability belongs on her face.

Return before And I could not explain it, aligned to exact words. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT

cards.title: EMOTION

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Your stomach is basically a muscle. It contracts, churns your food, and pushes everything forward. But GLP-1 medications slow those contractions down.
Single educational stomach cutaway; later motion is gentle wall contraction/churning, not a blocked valve.

cards.title: EMOTION

Cut on stomach is basically a muscle; cover about 4s, return or hold as aligned. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT

Overhead shallow river view: broad upstream pool feeding a narrow gentle trickle, a few floating leaves.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Understanding — translate slowed flow into the script’s metaphor.

Straight cut on Think of a river; hold 4s. A metaphor, never a clinical before/after. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Food backs up. Waste backs up. Gas builds with nowhere to go. And all that pressure is what you're feeling every single day.

cards.title: EMOTION

Cut on Food backs up for 3s; return before all that pressure lands. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It wasn't a diet problem. It wasn't something I was doing wrong. It was the gut slowdown.
Return to direct eye contact; slight release on It was the gut slowdown.

cards.title: EMOTION

cards.title: SCRIPT

cards.title: EMOTION

cards.title: SCRIPT

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:

cards.title: SCRIPT

cards.title: EMOTION

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: READING ORDER
cards.text: Read each UPDATED SCRIPT row left to right, then move down. All supplied narration is included exactly once in these rows. Reference frames are in their own lane.

cards.title: CURRENT SCRIPT
cards.text: 987 words; 48 thought beats, not 48 video clips. One supplied opening; old hook alternatives removed. All timing provisional.

cards.title: CAPTIONS & SOUND
cards.text: Black text on snug white boxes; 1–2 short lines. Continuous conversational voice across inserts. Keep face and captions clear. No music or SFX match is claimed.

cards.title: PRODUCT ENTRY
cards.text: The new script never says Motilli aloud. Show the exact Motilli product on So I found the same one. Preserve the script; add no spoken brand sentence.

cards.title: VISUAL VARIETY
cards.text: Every covering scene uses a distinct source and action. Dinner problem, dinner payoff and clearing plate are different compositions. Stomach, river and lumen diagram are distinct mechanism views.

cards.title: FIRST ASSET SET
cards.text: Selected GPT Image 2 presenter, candid inserts and overlays attached. Prior compatible images retained; expanded scenes generated for this revision. These are storyboard stills, not finished video.

cards.title: REFERENCE SCOPE
cards.text: Recovered Alicia Darling source and frame-level cut map retained. Transfer straight cuts, conversational presenter returns and caption style only. Reference frames are not Motilli assets or evidence.

cards.title: COPY & REPRESENTATION
cards.text: Group UI is visibly labeled illustrative recreation. No invented clinician quote, proof chart, body before/after or treatment animation. Supplied narration preserved; existing substantiation and representation dependencies remain.

cards.title: EDITOR HANDOFF
cards.text: Editing plan v5 is saved with the concept. Align cuts/captions to final voice; preserve performance speed. Future motion uses Google Omni and production editing uses DaVinci Resolve. No timeline or export created in this phase.
